name: rag-reranking
description: P1 Proof: a knowledge base reranked before the agent reads it — Cohere Rerank on its official SDK (cohere-ai) behind a code @Reranker, against a local stub of its documented API, swapped for AGBoss's LLM reranker by one line of the @Rag; the low-ranked answer reaches the agent first, the reranker's cost in the budget, a failure falls back.
